title: Rigidity of isometries on vector and normed lattices
summary: We study rigidity phenomena for maps on vector and normed lattices arising from isometric, order-theoretic, and modulus-preserving conditions. We first investigate the role of strict convexity in Baker's nonsurjective version of the Mazur-Ulam theorem. In the process, we develop a theory of midpoint injective functions and investigate their connections with convexity and monotonicity. Using this framework, we prove a generalization of Baker's theorem.
